name: LanceDB
summary: LanceDB is a vector and multimodal database built on the open-source Lance columnar format. The open-source version runs embedded in-process with no server, reading from local disk or object storage, while LanceDB Enterprise adds a distributed, managed deployment. It supports vector, full-text and hybrid search with SQL filters.
facts: Lance columnar files on local disk or object storage
Vector, full-text, hybrid, reranking, SQL filters
Embedded OSS library; LanceDB Enterprise (managed or private)
goodFor: Embedded vector search without running a server
Multimodal data (images, video, embeddings) in one table
Agent memory stored on object storage
watchOut: Scope is broader than a vector DB, which adds concepts to learn
